comparisons.name: collapsed-light
comparisons.description: The states example before any input, Aqua: two collapsed parents.

pixels.note: collapsed triangle of the first row, 8.5 to 16 pt from the edge: measured in Font Book (spec: outline-view)
collapsed triangle of the second row
no third row: content background

comparisons.name: expanded-light
comparisons.description: A click on the first triangle expands "a": two children appear, the first with a triangle one level in. The row is not selected. Aqua.

pixels.note: expanded triangle points down: its tip is under the middle of the 9 pt base, measured shape
child a1's triangle, indented by 16 pt (measured indentation)
nothing at level 1 in the child's row
a2 is a leaf: an empty triangle slot
b moved down to the fourth row
the click on the triangle did not select the row

comparisons.name: forced-colors-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours, with a1 selected and expanded by the keyboard: the selection is the system's highlight colour and its triangle the highlight text colour. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

pixels.note: a1 is selected: Highlight
its triangle: HighlightText
a is no longer selected: Canvas

comparisons.name: forced-colors-not-key-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours in a window that is not key, with a1 selected and expanded by the keyboard: the triangle of the selected row is still the highlight text colour, not its own grey. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

pixels.note: a1 is selected: Highlight
its triangle: HighlightText

comparisons.name: keyboard-light
comparisons.description: Click the first row, then Right Arrow twice and Right Arrow again: expands a, moves to a1, expands a1. Aqua.

pixels.note: a1 is selected and emphasised: measured selection colour (spec: table-view)
its triangle is expanded and white on the emphasised selection: measured in System Information
a is no longer selected
a1x, the third row, is not selected

comparisons.name: keyboard-left-dark
comparisons.description: Click the first row, Right Arrow twice, then Left Arrow: back on the parent, which stays expanded. Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: the parent is selected again: measured selection colour
white expanded triangle on the emphasised selection
a1's triangle in Dark Aqua: the spec's computed value, no measurement
a1 is no longer selected: dark content background, measured

comparisons.name: not-key-light
comparisons.description: The same click and Right Arrow in an inactive window: the row is selected in grey and its triangle keeps its grey. Inferred from the table view's measured grey selection.

pixels.note: unemphasised selection in a window that is not key
the triangle is not white on a grey selection

comparisons.name: reveal-light
comparisons.description: The reveal example as it opens, Aqua: revealedItem names item 40 of sixty, and the outline has scrolled just far enough to show it, so its row is the last of the three in view.

the first row in view is item 38, a leaf: content background
the second row in view is item 39, a leaf: content background
revealing the row did not select it: content background

comparisons.name: reveal-up-light
comparisons.description: A click on the row of item 40 selects it, and the example answers by naming item 2 in revealedItem: the outline scrolls up until that row is the first under the header. The selected row is out of view and the revealed one is not selected. Aqua.

pixels.note: collapsed triangle of item 2 in the first row under the header: the triangle colour measured in Font Book (spec: outline-view)
the second row in view is item 3, a leaf: content background
the third row in view is item 4, a leaf: the triangle of item 40 has scrolled away
the revealed row is not selected: content background
the selected row of item 40 was here and is out of view: content background
